# Edson Pimenta

> Bilingual portfolio for a software engineer focused on growth engineering,
> AI systems, and high-scale web architecture.

## Canonical pages

- [English portfolio](https://www.edsonpimenta.net/)
- [Portfólio em português](https://www.edsonpimenta.net/pt-br/)

## Profile

- Edson Pimenta has more than four years of professional software development
  experience.
- Primary technologies include PHP, Symfony, Slim, TypeScript, Node.js, React,
  Vue, Nuxt, Docker, and AWS.
- His work favors native platform capabilities, small client-side bundles,
  measurable outcomes, and pragmatic choices for each product.

## Selected work

- At Gran, Edson works on growth engineering, web performance, structured data,
  semantic systems, and AI initiatives for the organic platform.
- SchematicLD is a private, zero-dependency JSON-LD library designed and built
  by Edson. Gran owns the project; its source code and repository are not
  public.
- [Gran Questões](https://questoes.grancursosonline.com.br/) integrates
  SchematicLD into its Nuxt-rendered pages.
